items.title: Approve the Minutes of the May 9, 2023 Meeting
[Final Approval] Appoint Sean Kim as the District 1 Representative to the Community Advisory Committee
[Final Approval] State and Federal Legislation Update
[Final Approval] Allocate Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax Funds, to SFMTA the FY24 & FY25 Application-Based Residential Traffic Calming Program
[Final Approval] Approve Programming Priorities for Up to $5,640,041 in San Francisco’s Estimated Fiscal Year 2023/24 State Transit Assistance County Block Grant Funds
[Final Approval] Adopt the School Access Plan Final Report
Adopt Three Revised Job Classifications and a Revised Organization Chart
